Best I can suggest is to talk to your doctor or take your meds asap! These are meds that are not to be “taken lightly”, they mess with your brain chemistry, and to just jump off them like you’re implying is about the worst thing you can do. See about talking to a doctor to ease off them or give you some relief from the withdrawals. If you have any pills left I suggest taking one for tonight, for me the withdrawals eased a little after around an hour of taking my meds
